card.name: Linking words after Cushing's syndrome
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "Cushing's syndrome" in corticosteroid interaction warnings, as in "Cushing's syndrome and adrenal suppression". It also fires weakly on "include" or "as" near Cushing's syndrome signs.

modes.label: and after Cushing's syndrome
modes.description: The word "and" joins Cushing's syndrome to adrenal suppression in CYP3A inhibitor warnings.

modes.label: Listing Cushing signs
modes.description: A listing word such as "include" or "as" introduces signs and symptoms of Cushing's syndrome.
modes.example: Symptoms and signs of Cushing’s syndrome<< include>> weight gain, decreased height velocity, hyper

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts like "tor", "spinal" and "compact", which is a weak and mixed effect.
